name: Croatia
spiritual_teacher: Retreats / Islands (Quiet Dalmatian islands, yoga camps on Hvar and Korčula)
work_strategy: Remote (Digital Nomad Visa grants 0% local tax on foreign income, but requires proof of ~2 540 €/mo income; alternatively — Temporary Protection for Ukrainians)
it_market: Moderate (Developed hub in Zagreb — Rimac, Infobip; remote-only on the coast)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter 20–30% PIT + social contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: *Winter:* day +11...+14°C, night +5...+7°C (no snow, but cold stormy "Bura" wind occurs).
*Continental part (Zagreb):* annual mean **+11.5°C**, snowy winter (+3°C / -2°C), heating season 5–6 months (~120–160 €/mo).
nature: 🟢 **Top in Europe.** Crystal-clear Adriatic Sea, over 1000 islands, Plitvice Lakes, Velebit cliffs.
english_level: 🟢 **Easy.** Croatia ranks among the highest in the world for English proficiency (top-10 in Europe). Croatian is a Slavic language and easy to understand.
housing_rent: ⚠️ **Main coastal risk:** Most landlords rent only until June 1 ("do sezone"), after which they evict tenants for tourists or raise prices 3–4x. Finding a year-round contract requires great care.
*Total minimum cost of living:* **~800–950 €/mo** (much more expensive than Romania/Bulgaria/Georgia).

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Biometric or internal passport. Police registration within 48 hours.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary Protection (Privremena zaštita) valid until March 4, 2027. A protected foreigner card and OIB (tax number) are issued.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: Croatia is an EU member, so the 31.07.2026 rule requiring proof of legal exit/deferment applies. Having an official deferment fully satisfies these requirements.
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: One-time financial aid (Jednokratna novčana pomoć) from social welfare centers (Centar za socijalnu skrb) — up to 330 € per person or 460 € per family (not granted to everyone).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Temporary Protection grants entitlement to mandatory health insurance (HZZO) — free emergency and basic care at public facilities.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work with the protection card.

items: [Njuškalo.hr](https://www.njuskalo.hr/iznajmljivanje-stanova) — absolute #1 monopoly in Croatia (80%+ of all listings).
[Index Oglasi](https://www.index.hr/oglasi/najam-stanova/gid/3207) — second most popular portal, many direct-from-owner listings with zero realtor commission.
[Crozilla.com](https://www.crozilla.com/en/rent) — convenient portal with an English interface for foreigners.
[Flatio.com](https://www.flatio.com/housing/croatia) — monthly rentals for digital nomads with no deposit for 1–6 months.
